description: Exploratory combination of two independently 3/3-seed improving removals: ch_ch_t035_equatorial_area and strip_v650_dark. Original A otherwise unchanged, alpha=.25, full spectral term, no B1. Fixed arithmetic mean of fresh seeds 42/43/44; equal 1/3 weights, no label-fitted weights. Official F1/F2/F3, training-only calibration and 144h maturity. Selected after prior official LOCO scores; no independent confirmation claim.
